generation.definition: factual_pass reruns assess_factual on the saved answer, claims, hits, and relationship prompt facts. numeric_pass is recomputed by that same call. The saved numeric_pass is the value stored at generation time.
generation.ranked_retrieval_metrics: null because this experiment published no graded qrels

profile_crosswalk.reason: Hybrid passages under prompt contract factual-reliability-v1. The source profile was not used.
In-passage relationship block from generation_relationships. Not the relationships profile.
Matched dense search over pilot texts, truncated to a 400-character preview. Not the active Chroma index.
Blog-only token pad. It is not the descriptions profile and it is not multi-hop.

retrieval.definition: Overlap with a preselected id list. The historical notes say this is not precision or recall. Replay precision, recall, MRR, and nDCG stay null.
